name: Family Affair
source:
The story of the game tells us of the Robertson family, in which passion, lies and misunderstandings are intertwined.

The protagonist of the game, a college student, young and lustful, plunges into a quagmire of puberty with accompanying vices. The main character is destined to meet many interesting persons, vivid situations and difficult decisions.

Where will the Family Affair take you personally?

[From F95Zone]
